snippet.title: Under Development: The game about making games!
snippet.description:
Spanning over 30 years from 1981 to 2011 and beyond, "Under Development" puts the controller in your hands at gaming's most pivotal moments. Whether you aspire to make games or play them, Under Development is an affectionate tribute to the ultimate art form.

The game is free to download for PC here:
http://download.cnet.com/Under-Development/3000-2119_4-75598574.html
